svg.text: What the poller does with my handler's return value
The Lambda poller deletes or keeps each message based on how my invocation ended. Same batch of 10 in every row; only #7 failed.
A Success → not listed → the poller deletes it.
B Hide this one message for 20 · 2ⁿ⁻¹ s, then list it.
C This dict goes back to the poller. Nothing in my code reads it again.
HOW THE INVOCATION ENDED → WHAT THE POLLER DOES
empty / null / an id not in this batch
mine never raises, so this is a
The docstring says that without ReportBatchItemFailures "Lambda retries the WHOLE batch". That only happens
when the handler raises (row 3). My handler catches every exception and returns normally, so with the setting
off it lands in row 5: the poller sees a success, deletes all 10, and failed messages never reach the DLQ.
The setting is ON in my event source mapping, so the deployed system is fine. Only the comment is wrong.
WHY "SILENCE = FAILURE" IS THE SAFE DEFAULT
The poller deletes only what it is sure succeeded. If my function crashes, hangs or returns garbage, nothing is deleted, every message
reappears after its visibility timeout, and SQS keeps counting receives. Work is never lost by accident; at worst it runs twice, which is
why every write in the worker is keyed by the S3 object key or vectorKey and overwrites instead of duplicating.
